For \(T=J_2(0)\), \(\mu_T=x^2\), while
   \[
   m_{T,0}=1,\qquad m_{T,e_1}=x,\qquad m_{T,e_2}=x^2.

## Nonfatal

3. **`thm-cyclic-subspace-power-basis-and-companion-matrix` — `[L1]`**

   The [Given and `[L1]`](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-cyclic-subspace-power-basis-and-companion-matrix.md:32) omit finite dimensionality, while the cited proposition is expressly finite-dimensional.    The required divisibility equivalence follows immediately by unpacking “monic generator,” so the mathematical gap is under the 30-second threshold.

   **Severity: nonfatal — false boundary dispositions, but no surviving mathematical gap.**
